meta.name: e2e-testing
meta.description: Playwright E2E testing patterns, Page Object Model, configuration, CI/CD integration, artifact management, and flaky test strategies.

copy.tagline: 用 Playwright 编写可靠端到端测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在浏览器中自动化测试用户流程
copy.tagline_en: Write reliable end-to-end tests with Playwright
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser-based user flow testing

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据 Playwright 最佳实践生成端到端测试代码，包括页面对象模型、测试结构、配置、CI/CD 集成、工件管理和处理不稳定测试的策略。
howto.when: 当用户要求编写或优化 Playwright 端到端测试，或询问测试组织、配置、CI/CD 集成、不稳定测试处理等问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一个登录页面的端到端测试。
say.note: Claude 会生成基于页面对象模型的测试代码。

say.text: 如何配置 Playwright 在 CI 中运行测试？
say.note: Claude 会提供 CI/CD 集成配置示例。

say.text: 我的测试不稳定，怎么处理？
say.note: Claude 会给出隔离不稳定测试和修复常见原因的建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate end-to-end test code following Playwright best practices, including Page Object Model, test structure, configuration, CI/CD integration, artifact management, and strategies for handling flaky tests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to write or optimize Playwright end-to-end tests, or asks about test organization, configuration, CI/CD integration, or flaky test handling.

say_en.text: Generate an end-to-end test for a login page.
say_en.note: Claude will generate test code based on the Page Object Model.

say_en.text: How to configure Playwright to run tests in CI?
say_en.note: Claude will provide CI/CD integration configuration examples.

say_en.text: My tests are flaky, how to handle that?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest quarantining flaky tests and fixing common causes.
